pages: Kuku? (Are you gonna feed me?)
Peep peep... (Ugh, what a drag...)
Peep? (Are you gonna eat me?)
Beep? (Am I cute?)
Peep peep! (I don't ever wanna grow up!)
Come to think of it...
That old lady in Greenhell... said something, didn't she?
Something about the way opening for those who seek it...
Come to think of it...
The old priestess in Greenhell told us something, didn't she?
The way shall open to those who seek it, or so...
Oh! Come to think of it...
The shaman lady in Greenhell said something, right?
Seek, and ye shall find, you know!
Something just came to mind...
The elder priestess in Greenhell told us something...
Only to those who seek it will the way be opened, she said.
Oh! I remember now!
Granny in Greenhell said something!!
...Umm... what was it again?
Something just came to mind...
I believe the Greenhell shaman told us something...
The way opens to those who seek it, she said.
Hey, hey, come to think of it...
Didn't the shaman lady in Greenhell say something?
Like, if you go looking for it, there's always a way?
Hold, wait a moment!
I have just recalled what the Greenhell shaman
told us, I have!
The way opens to those who seek it, she said!
The shaman in Greenhell said...
the way opens only to those who seek it... but
is that really true...?
That's right!
Moping around won't get us anywhere!
Mizuki busting your bell ain't nearly enough
to stop us in our tracks!
That's right!
The way opens only to those who seek it!
Don't give up!
We've always pulled together before,
and we've overcome every hardship, haven't we?
Exactly! Those are some fine words!
We've made it this far by working together.
Right?
I see...! You are right.
Losing the bell and Sieger was a heavy blow to us.
But we have also destroyed Animus Bells and hurt Mizuki.
...We are by no means outmatched!
If, as the shaman said,
we still have the power to open the way...
then there must be something here!
Granny was right!
We always worked hard together before!
It'll be okay, Reon! I just know it!!
...Yeah. You're right.
Anyway, let's take that first step...
Nothing starts unless we start walking...
I'll tell you just one thing...
As you are now, you're not even worth rusting my blade.
If you're going to whine, get lost!
Fool!
Nakoruru...
Cham Cham...
Kyoshiro...
Rimururu...
It is a technique completed
by supplementing it with the power of your souls!
It is a technique completed
by supplementing it with the power of your soul!
Indeed... I am the great sorcerer Holy.
What do you want with me?
Ho ho ho...
You want to learn magic from an old man who can't even go outside?
...I refuse! Go home! Go home!
Hiii! What can I do ya for?
See ya, baby!
That's plenty good for you.
How much do you want it worked?
Leave it to me, baby!
It's done, baby!
Hiii! Can I help you?
Anything else I can do for you?
Which one will it be?
Nobody can equip that, you know.
Shall I equip it?
Who will equip it?
Which one should come off?
What will you sell?
You can't carry any more money.
Looks like you have nothing to sell.
Is that all right?
Gfu?
I'll give back all the other loot I stole, too!
251.question: Please, spare my life!

pages: Thaaank ya kindly! I'll give it my best shot!
Treasure... like the Palenque Stone, maybe?
Huh? Pak Pak! What's this?
A doll of a kind lady... She's just like Mama.
Whew... what troublesome people...
Now, let's get outside. This must be the treasure the Elder meant.
Now then... the treasure the Elder spoke of
...must be this.
Hmph... what a nuisance.
So... this is the old man's treasure.
Hi-yah! Cham Cham won't lose!
Okay, this is the treasure, right? Let's take it back quick!
What the hell! Ya ain't tough at all...
Hey! Boys!
Take this garbage out and dump it!
And make sure ya give the Elder my regards...
Tell 'em that's what ya get for crossin' the Earth family! Gfufufu...
That Earthquake...
I hope this is the last of his villainy.
Now, is this the treasure the Elder mentioned?
Calling your own faith heathen... These Christians
are a servile lot.
You mustn't call the faith you believe in heathen.
So you are... the people called Christians.
Over a hundred years ago? Hmm... maybe...
...I... can't say anything...
...Just get out of this village already!
I thought you were good people... What a joke...
Aww, from now on... we'll have to live in fear.
Damn, so what if you're a little strong...
Don't get cocky. Heaven will punish you soon enough...
Thanks to you, I won't get any sleep from now on either.
Lady Toki? Hey, I heard that somewhere before!
Over a hundred years ago? Then maybe Lady Toki too...
What... a hundred years ago? Then...
Over a hundred years ago? Nonsense! Not just Amakusa Shiro,
are you saying this Lady Toki has come back to life too?
Over a hundred years ago? That makes my head spin!
Huh!? Could it be...!
Oh... flowers in the shape of a cross... I see...
Hmph... even their flowers are planted as crosses.
What can I do for you?
Anything else you need?
This is plenty good for you.
All right, leave it to me!
Is there anything else?
Which would you like?
No one can equip that, I'm afraid.
Would you like to equip it?
Who will be equipping it?
Thanks be to God!
You can't carry any more money.
You don't seem to have anything to sell.
Who was that just now...? A blade edged with such deep sorrow...
Who was that guy? Somehow...
it doesn't feel like we beat him, does it?
Hmph... what a nuisance of a man.
Ahh... my beloved Lord Amakusa...
Just as you commanded, I've disposed of the pests...
But man, I sure am strong, ain't I...
Too bad you didn't get some dark power from Lord Amakusa too...
Uhyahyahyahya...
I... I can't go on... my strength is fading...
I'm sorry, everyone...
Rimururu...
Fa... Father...
I get it...
That bastard Mitsurugi had this cave bound with dark power!
This cave was originally a sacred place...
It seems Mitsurugi sealed its holy power with evil.
Looks like this was a holy place all along...
And it seems our power is back to normal, too.
With Mitsurugi's death,
this cave seems to have regained its holy power.
Hmph... so Mitsurugi
was suppressing this cave's holy power with dark magic.
Amakusa... this is getting more and more interesting.
We beat Mitsurugi, so the cave got all clean, huh!
To have turned this sacred cave into a den of demons...
Dark power is not to be underestimated!
Hmm! It seems that wretch Mitsurugi Doukou
was defiling this sacred cave with dark power!
But now all is as it was!
Wow!
So this place wasn't really a demon den after all!
Mitsurugi's, no, Amakusa's magic made it all weird!
Grrrr...!
...Hmm. You're headed for the demon realm, you say?
I see. You look pretty handy with a blade.
Then how about running that Mitsurugi out of Ise for us?
Everybody's sick of that guy...
Well, I won't force you or nothin'.
So you're the one who took out Mitsurugi!
Thanks a bunch!!
Whoa! You finally took out Mitsurugi!
Just like I figured you would!
Thanks a bunch!! Say, as a token of thanks...
Go on, hand over your weapons!!!
I'll work 'em for ya!! Free of charge, of course!
There, all done! How's that, the best, right!?
Now go slice and dice those demons!
A weird samurai named Mitsurugi Doukou keeps threatenin' folks in Ise.
...He cuts down anyone who looks like a samurai,
it's plumb scary.
Folks like you'd best be careful.
Tasty, wasn't it? Ise's the place for seafood!
Recovered some HP!
A few shogunate spies came
here to Ise from the Kanto area.
But it seems Mitsurugi cut most of 'em down.
Hey, you! Why're ya skippin' the cleanup?
Skippin' the big yearly cleanup to go play outside...
The nerve of ya!
...Honestly, I can't figure out what gals these days are thinkin'!
And don't go walkin' around with a monkey!
Back!
Well, well! Ukyo, you sly dog...
Hiding such a beauty from us all this time!
I see...
I see a great weight of destiny upon you.
I had hoped I might be of some help...
You haven't enough money...
You ought to at least know what's in your purse.
For a woman, you are quite aggressive.
...Good or bad? That is for you to choose.
Whether you realize it or not,
your fighting instinct leads you down the path of carnage...
But you could choose another path, I think.
The way of the sword is the path of carnage...
Whether one finds purpose in trading lives
is a matter of personal taste.
Whatever your true heart may be,
endless battle leads you down the path of carnage...
It seems you have forgotten that there is another path.
Is it misfortune to cut, or to be cut?
...That, I cannot say.
I know only one thing.
You... can do nothing but cut!
That is all.
You walk a path that is dark, yet straight...
A dark, straight path...
What a warm soul...
A soul like that is precious in this world. Cherish it.
You seem a gentle young woman...
May your kindness reach the demons,
just as it reaches the animals.
...You are a kind man.
Though on the path of the sword, that may be your undoing...
Your strength lies not in your swordsmanship.
With such strength of heart, you can walk the true path of the sword.
Hmm... darkness coexists with light...
How strange... You are a strange man...
You are like a supple blade!
You hold both the fierce edge of steel and a gentle, embracing heart.
What... was that?
I'm sorry, Mamahaha.
Without you here, I'd worry about Kamuy Kotan.
How very touching... Just like a scene from a play.
Ukyo... I'm so glad! You got to see her!
Continue your training! Farewell!!
Hold! Do not let your guard down!
Evil reaches even toward the sacred shrine of Ise!
Hmm, not bad. Keep it up!
My journey continues until peace returns... Farewell!
Wait, stay alert! Anyone who claims to serve Amakusa
must not be taken lightly!
So this one was small fry as well. Until we meet again!
Heh... Ukyo.
Now you can't let the flower of your life scatter so easily!
Helloooo! Are you seeking power?
Hmm... if you're already that strong,
you don't really need training, do you?
Don't be greedy, okay?
So, wanna give training a try?
339.question: Train?

pages: Okay, here we go!
He may look like a cute little bear, but don't let your guard down!
Aww... how boring. Bye!
Wowww! That's a first!
Good work! Keep it up from here on, okay?
Don't be disappointed... I'll give you one more chance.
Tee hee... This offer is good o-n-l-y once, okay?
Now Myoutoiwa's back to bein' Ise's famous sight!!
Thanks a lot!
That man Mitsurugi is an assassin from Hell...
He has done away with several shogunate spies and officials here in Ise.
The townsfolk of Ise are also troubled by his bizarre behavior.
What say you? Will you deal with Mitsurugi for us?
With a minion of Hell wandering about, anything could happen.
I hear you have brought Mitsurugi Doukou to justice.
He was a pitiful man, when I think of it,
but now the people of Ise can live in peace!
...You said you wished to know about Hell.
I hear Mitsurugi has made his lair in Myoutoiwa Cave...
Defeat him and put the people of Ise at ease!
I see... So you got Mitsurugi...
He was a pitiful man, when I think of it.
But you truly live up to Hakudou's recommendation!
Most reassuring!
Leave Ise to me, and head west...
Let me see...
The movements of Hell are surely rising from the west.
Some say it all begins somewhere in Kyushu...
I hear strange women are bewitching people in Osaka.
...Be careful.
A ronin named Mitsurugi's been wandering around Ise...
He cuts people down in the street and suddenly screams nonsense.
Lord Amakusaaa, he yells. Who's that supposed to be?
Anyway...
Well? Tasty, wasn't it?
Taste aside... you feel fired up!
That Mitsurugi Doukou guy...
Rumor has it he drifted in from Kansai...
There sure are a lot of weirdos from Kansai, honestly.
Amakusa's power!?
I'm so jealous...
I want a guy like Ukyo too!
Yagyuuu Jubeee? What a funny name!
Damn it!
He's gonna cut down everyone in town one by one!?
I won't let him!
...I thought he was just strange, but it seems we can't leave him be.
That bastard! He's gonna kill the people of Ise!
My justice won't allow it!
...So he is not merely an eccentric, but a villain as well.
We cannot leave him be...
He's not just weird, he's a bad guy!
If we don't beat him, the people of Ise won't be safe!
Hyohohohoho! Lord Amakusa! Your Mitsurugi has done it again!
Now! Tell me who my next prey will be!
Hyohhohohoho!
Boo hoo hoo...
Thanks to my cranky master, I'm the one who gets caught in the crossfire.
No one can equip that.
Who'll be equipping it?
Which one should come off?
You can't carry any more money.
Looks like you've got nothing to sell.
How about it? Pretty addictive, huh?
...Recovered a good amount of SP!
Ise's got this legend of Princess Bizuki...
Long ago, a real tough gal named Bizuki
took three followers and drove the demons out of Ise.
...If you're curious, ask the old man at the Grand Shrine.
Traveler... where do you hail from?
No one comes from the east anymore...
Folks and goods from the western road have dropped off, too.
What's goin' on out there?
What! Anjou village destroyed?
Is that true? I can't just sit here!
......Outside the village is crawlin' with demons.
There's no way I could make it to Anjou...
Deep in the cave up ahead, there used to be demons...
There's a legend that a mighty great priestess
drove 'em out.
Like, oh my god! Totally freaky, right?
Gotta catch it on the gossip shows later, y'know!
No way, like, demons?? Seriously? Seriously?
Come to think of it, Reon! That bell that got broken...
Where'd you get it?
...What's this all of a sudden...
My bell? It was a sacred treasure handed down from my ancestors...
For hundreds of years my clan has waited
for the day Mizuki would awaken...
So we could defeat Mizuki!!!
...That's a little hard for you, Cham Cham?
...It means from my mother's mother's mother...
and even further back than that...
People from long ago...? Hmm... I see.
......No...... it's nothing...
......Hmm...... No problem...
......Nope... It's nothing!
...... Haon must have gone to Kyoto!
Let's hurry!
...Mizukiiiii!!
I've punished many villains, but you I can never forgive!
How was it? Tasty, huh?
Recovered more HP than expected!
It's been nothing but bad news lately...
Thanks to the demons, no tourists come at all...
Just between us, word is some terrible demon attacked Edo
and wiped out the whole city!
Folks even say the Shogun fled to Nikko or thereabouts.
They've added all sorts of believable details, too.
Tremendous evil is pouring out of Haon's body...
...What is this power?
No! This power is... very bad!
Cough... this power... is truly not to be underestimated!
Well... I know it's a lot to ask you to believe,
but it's true.
Reon... your bell...
Where'd you get it?
Didn't you inherit that bell from your ancestors?
Along with lots of techniques
passed down to defeat Mizuki...
Your clan's long-cherished wish was to defeat Mizuki.
To fulfill it, they passed down their mission, will and skills, did they not?
Was not that broken bell one of those things?
Whatever... It makes no difference to me.
Reon! Maybe the bell is
a treasure that your grandpas and grandmas
left for you
so you could beat Mizuki?
The three followers who were at Bizuki's side were...
me... Hion, who looks just like you, and...
that Haon!
